context: One PR, mechanical deletions, no logic changes. Verify the CI path-filter change doesn't orphan other classifier rules. CLAUDE.md/AGENTS.md edits follow docs-brevity style. After merge, run the export workflow manually once to confirm the committed snapshot is unchanged in shape.
description: Single demolition PR after the phase-5 freeze cycle completes and all gates hold. Deletes the tracked _project/blind-spots/*.md records and retires every machinery surface the adversarial review's M6 inventoried: sweep_blind_spots.py + its tests, Makefile blind-spots-{list,report,sweep} targets (Makefile:2077-2085, .PHONY :1290, help :2397-2400), the .gitignore:169 un-ignore line for _project/blind-spots/, path-filters.yml safe-content (:10) and content-guard (:42) entries, and the CLAUDE.md pre-approved 'make blind-spots-*' commands + blind-spot capture-path bindings. KEEPS: validate_blind_spot.py (retargeted in phase 1 as the draft validator), the /blind-spot command (rewritten in phase 1), and README.md content relocated to docs/development/ as the findings-domain doc. Git HISTORY IS UNTOUCHED — the 61 commits and record contents remain readable in history per the phase-0 owner decision; rewriting history is a separate destructive action requiring separate authorization. HARD ENTRY GATES: (a) one full planning cycle elapsed since the freeze; (b) at least one finding was surfaced via the standard flow (ready/stats banner -> candidates) and triaged during that cycle — the requirement-2 proof; (c) phase-2 export pinning test and phase-3 non-claimability suite still green on develop.

anti_patterns.dont: Bundle history rewriting (filter-repo/BFG) into this PR
anti_patterns.instead: Tree deletion only; history question stays with the owner
anti_patterns.why: Destructive, separately-authorized decision per phase 0; also breaks every historical SHA reference

anti_patterns.dont: Delete before the freeze-cycle proof exists
anti_patterns.why: The freeze cycle is the only evidence window proving the new flow actually surfaces findings (requirement 2); deleting early destroys the rollback path

item_meta.blocked_reason: Entry gates NOT met, verified 2026-07-30 against production rather than assumed. (1) The freeze began TODAY (README notice, PR #1359); the gate is a full planning cycle AFTER the freeze, and the freeze IS the rollback window -- demolishing now deletes the only fallback if a parity problem surfaces. (2) The '>=1 finding triaged through the new flow' precondition is NOT satisfied: production finding_events contains ONLY import=64, imported_triage_log=260, sync=1 -- ZERO triage/disposition/promote/link events. The 3 actionable / 29 actioned / 32 promoted dispositions are imported historical status mapped from Markdown 'status:' by STATUS_TO_DISPOSITION, not proof that the new triage flow works on production. An earlier note in this effort claimed this gate was 'arguably already satisfied'; that was wrong. (3) findings-evidence-tree-record-disposition should land first: that file is UNTRACKED, so phase 6's deletion of tracked _project/blind-spots/*.md would silently miss it. Unblock when a planning cycle has elapsed AND at least one finding has been triaged via 'todo finding triage' on production.
